svg.text: code_tracer — Physical topology: what is written where, read by whom
Stores, not services. Red border = a component we build.
W: what is WRITTEN into this store — or, for an actor, what it writes out
R: what is READ from this store — or, for an actor, what it reads in
solid arrow = write path · dashed arrow = read path · green = admitted artifact
PUBLIC UPSTREAM · the anchor — nobody in the alliance controls it · write access: none of ours
Anchor strength varies: Maven/Go strong · npm, PyPI permit
deletion, so a baseline can vanish → supplementary log
OUTSIDE · alliance (issuer) · maker · verifier quorum — evidence PRODUCTION
publishing surface — never read at verify
R: baseline from package registry · source from upstream git · L-1 contract
W: hardened artifact · L0–L7 attestations · recipe set (own git)
W: delivery manifest (L-1 + L0–L7), digest logged at hand-off
the maker's git holds recipes only — peripheral, never on the verification path
Verifier quorum — n ≈ active membership (verification is a duty) — not ours
R: delivery manifest · baseline re-pulled from the public registry (independent anchor check)
W: one VSA each — rebuild digest, L4/L5 recheck, conformance, observed Rekor checkpoint
k = max(3, ceil(n/3)) · zero dissent · divergent checkpoints or digests are disqualifying
siting is hybrid — mostly peer on-prem, so the rebuild harness must be a distributable package
by replay, so omission is detectable
THE PERIMETER — crossed by ONE evidence bundle (OCI index; deterministic tar when air-gapped). A copy, not a protocol. Container, never a credential.
RESOLUTION is online · VERIFICATION is offline
INSIDE THE BANK · hermetic and offline — no live call outward at verify time · evidence CONSUMPTION
refreshed on a cadence, never at verify
W on admit · R by app teams only
W: candidate on arrival · nothing reads it but the gate
R only: which apps deploy which candidate
R: projections + verdicts · writes nothing durable
Every durable write inside the bank is append-only:
verdicts and bundles are immutable, ledger events are
hash-chained. Everything else is a projection.
· It is not "two GitHubs." Git appears twice — the alliance master repo (schemas, policy, compiler) and the maker's recipe repo — and is load-bearing in neither.
· Artifact bytes are never duplicated: they stay in the ecosystem-native repo. A central digest→attestation index supplies discovery, and it is deliberately untrusted.
· The master repo is a PUBLISHING surface. Nothing inside the bank reads it at verify time — schema and policy ship pinned inside the bundle, or hermeticity is broken.
· Open: verifier rebuild siting (hybrid → distributable harness) · the air-gapped courier variant and its staging hosts on each side of the perimeter.
